mapper.sql: select message_id, message_title, message_type, cast(message_content as char) as message_content, message_level, biz_source, biz_id, redirect_url, recipient_id, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from sys_message
mapper.insert: insert into sys_message ( message_title, message_type, message_content, message_level, biz_source, biz_id, redirect_url, recipient_id, status, remark, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{messageTitle}, #{messageType}, #{messageContent}, #{messageLevel}, #{bizSource}, #{bizId}, #{redirectUrl}, #{recipientId}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.select: select count(*) from sys_message m where m.status = '1' and (m.recipient_id is null or m.recipient_id = #{userId}) and not exists (select 1 from sys_message_read r where r.message_id = m.message_id and r.user_id = #{userId})

select m.message_id as messageId, m.message_title as messageTitle, m.message_type as messageType, m.message_level as messageLevel, m.biz_source as bizSource, m.biz_id as bizId, m.redirect_url as redirectUrl, m.message_content as messageContent, m.create_by as createBy, m.create_time as createTime, case when r.message_id is not null then true else false end as isRead, r.read_time as readTime from sys_message m left join sys_message_read r on r.message_id = m.message_id and r.user_id = #{userId} where m.status = '1' and (m.recipient_id is null or m.recipient_id = #{userId}) order by m.message_id desc limit #{limit}
mapper.insert: insert ignore into sys_message_read (message_id, user_id, read_time) values (#{messageId}, #{userId}, sysdate())

insert ignore into sys_message_read (message_id, user_id, read_time) values
